title: A Filtered MgNet Solver For Radiative Transfer Equations
summary: Conventional numerical solvers for the radiative transfer equation (RTE) exhibit severe sensitivity to medium parameters. To address this, we propose an operator learning framework that approximates the RTE solution map as a function of material properties. The core architecture, MgNet, preserves the solution operator framework established by recursive skeleton factorization (RSF) but substitutes its coefficient-specific sub-operators (e.g. smoother, prolongation operator and restriction operator) with learnable neural components.
